website_summary.name: Holiday Wishes Tree
website_summary.description: The website features a festive interface with a virtual Christmas tree where users can leave personalized messages and virtual gifts for friends.
website_summary.appearance: The website has a clean and festive design with a pastel yellow background. On the left side, there is a stylized Christmas tree made up of three green triangles, with a brown base decorated with various gift icons. On the right side, there is a white card-like section with a dark blue header that reads "Holiday Wishes Tree." Below the header, there is a description of the tree's purpose. Two prominent buttons, "Create Tree" and "Decorate Tree," are displayed below the description. Further down, there are sections for "Selected Gifts" and "Friend Messages," where users can view and add gifts and messages. At the bottom, there are buttons for sharing the tree, downloading an image, and saving it to a collection.
website_summary.functionality: The website allows users to create and decorate a virtual Christmas tree. Users can add gifts and personalized messages for friends. The "Create Tree" button initiates the creation of a new tree, while the "Decorate Tree" button allows users to customize their tree. Users can also view friend messages and selected gifts. Additionally, there are options to share the tree, download an image of it, and save it to a collection.
